caption: The drawing depicts a stylized human figure standing on a rectangular base. The figure has a light brown face with a pointed beard and a mustache, and features a prominent, upright three-pronged black headdress or hairstyle. The arms are bent at the elbows with hands positioned outward. The figure is dressed in a brown long-sleeved upper garment, over which a loose, light beige, sleeveless outer robe is draped, decorated with a wavy line and dot pattern at the bottom hem. The lower half of the robe spreads outward, partially obscuring a dark brown lower garment. The rectangular base is colored yellowish-brown with a diamond border pattern along its visible edge. The background is plain off-white, and a small number "30" is printed near the bottom left corner.
title: Plate 39: St. John Nepomuk Bulto: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
